tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 hrīḥ ka dag spros dang bral ba'i zhing khams nas// bon sku kun tu bzang po la gsol ba 'debs// sna tshogs 'gag med rol pa'i zhing khams nas// longs sku rgyal ba 'dus pa la gsol ba 'debs// gang 'dul thabs bstan ma nges zhing khams nas// sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// dbyings klong thabs shes zung 'brel zhing khams nas// dbyangs can ye shes mtsho rgyal la gsol ba 'debs// phyogs med dag snang 'char ba'i zhing khams nas// lo chen bai ro tsa na la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dul ba'i zhing khams nas// o rgyan mchog gyur gling pa la gsol ba 'debs// sngon bzang smon lam 'brel ba'i zhing khams nas// zab don chos kyi bdag po la gsol ba 'debs// spyi gtsug 'gyur med bde ba'i zhing khams nas// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// dbang bzhi lus la rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs// mchog thun dngos grub thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par

bsam/ zhes dbang drag 'bar ba'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs 'di ni gter chen mchog gi bka' phebs ltar/ dngos slob rgyal ba g.yung drung bstan 'dzin pas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
